title: Crisp gnocchi with Brussels sprouts and brown butter

source.title: Crisp Gnocchi With Brussels Sprouts and Brown Butter

instructions: Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts. Peel thick strips of zest from the lemon and chop them coarsely, to get about 2 tsp.

Heat 3 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the sprouts, season with ½ tsp salt and a few grinds of pepper, and arrange them cut side down in one layer. Scatter the zest over the top and cook, undisturbed, until well browned underneath, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the red-pepper flakes, stir, and cook until crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.

In the same skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil over medium-high. Break up any gnocchi stuck together, add them to the pan and cook, covered and undisturbed, until golden on one side, 2 to 4 minutes.

Add the butter and honey, season with salt and a generous amount of pepper, and cook, stirring, until the butter is golden, nutty and foaming, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in the sprouts until warmed through. Serve with grated Parmesan.
